Sensitivity of the model to a species parameter

Source: R/run_batch.R
param_sensitivity.Rd

param_sensitivity runs the model with different values of one parameter of the species file (with run_batch) and plots the annual values of the selected output variables.

Usage

param_sensitivity(
  param,
  value,
  variable,
  inputdir,
  outputdir,
  ...,
  parallel = FALSE
)

Arguments

param

Character: name of the parameter of the species file (e.g. "LIGHT_TOL").

value

Numeric vector: values of the parameter.

variable

Character vector: variables of the annual output to plot (e.g. c("GPP", "NPP")).

inputdir

Character: input directory used by the runs without an inputdir column.

outputdir

Character: directory of the runs. Each run is saved in outputdir/id/input and outputdir/id/output. Keep it short: the model cannot write paths longer than 260 characters.

...

Other arguments of run_3DCMCCFEM (at least site, species, year_start, year_end, man). The output is always annual.

parallel

Logical: run the simulations in parallel with the future framework (package future.apply)? The future plan set by the user is used, e.g. future::plan("multisession", workers = 4). Default to FALSE

Value

A list with data (data.frame with YEAR, the value of the parameter, variable and value) and plot (a ggplot object).

See also

run_batch, set_species_param

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
inp <- system.file("extdata", "bilykriz", "rcp0p0", package = "R3DFEM")
s <- param_sensitivity("LIGHT_TOL", 1:4, c("GPP", "NPP", "HEIGHT"),
                       inputdir = inp, outputdir = "C:/sim/sens",
                       site = "BilyKriz", species = "Piceaabies",
                       year_start = 1997, year_end = 2050, man = "off")
s$plot
} # }
